text: The ancient forest is quiet. Sunlight falls across the moss-covered stones beside a narrow stream.
Aria Moonwhisper is an elven ranger with silver hair and a worn green cloak. She watches the forest path carefully.
Make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, take 8 points of fire damage.
The door opens. Привет, путник! Take a seat.
Franz offers Aria Moonwhisper a room. Roll 1d20 + 5.
The old innkeeper offers you a room for the night.
